article.title: The weaponisation of the dollar
article.author: Prabhat Patnaik
article.content: The Bretton Woods system institutionalized the U.S. dollar as a global reserve currency, with the U.S. pledging to buy and sell gold from foreign governments and central banks at a fixed price of $35 per ounce of gold. The post The weaponisation of the dollar appeared first on MR Online .
